Messages.Author: Magnus
Messages.Body:
A question came up today during a game. Masika, with 4 blood and an
Palatial Estate, was banished back to the uncontrolled. Several
players contended that the Palatial Estate should still work, while I
contended the opposite, as Masika was considered uncontrolled, and
therefore the equipment on him shouldn´t work at all.
So, should the Palatial Estate give Masika blood during the untap
phase, although he is uncontrolled, or shouldn´t it?

Magnus

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"Magnus" <magn...@gmx.de> wrote in message
news:70eabfe1.0406...@posting.google.com...


it does not give him blood : the palatial estate is in the uncontrolled
region and its effect is suspended until the vampires returns in the
controller region.
Same stuff for blood doll or the rack : they have no effect since the
vampire is out of the controlled region.

still in the controlled region and can be stolen as normal, but it does not
give blood to the targetted vampire.

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:


Shouldn't.

1) Palatial Estate is equipment, and so is put on Masika. When Masika
moves to the uncontrolled region, the Palatial Estate does to, putting
it out of play. So it doesn't work, can't be arsoned, doesn't count for
contesting, etc.

2) That aside, cards can only affect other cards in play without
explicit card text. So even if Palatial Estate would stay in play for
some reason, it still wouldn't affect Masika, as it lacks any card text
saying it can affect uncontrolled vampires. See also: The Rack, which
does stay in play, but ceases to have an effect if its vampire leaves
the controlled region.

--Colin McGuigan
